title: 第二十七章第二十八章第二十九章
slug: 纳玄尘第五十三章安凌
content_zh:
苏尘没有回王府。
三年了，这个习惯已经自然得不像习惯——练功晚了、想事情入神了、或者只是懒得走那两刻钟的路回府，他就直接在马场歇下了。一开始青萝还会送换洗衣裳过来，后来柳含烟也习惯了，偶尔差人带句话来，说“记得添件衣裳，别着凉“，就不再催他回去了。
硬板床不如王府的软，但他早就睡惯了。
只是今晚睡不着。
那个记号在脑子里转了一整夜。
苏尘躺在硬板床上，眼睛盯着房梁上被油灯熏黑的那道纹路，看着它在黑暗里慢慢模糊、又慢慢清晰。窗外什么动静都没有了，只有马棚里偶尔传来一阵蹄子磕地面的闷响，然后是草料被拱动的窸窣声，再然后又是一片安静。
他已经躺了两个时辰了。睡不着。
脑子里的那个尖角和弧线翻来覆去地转，像一根卡在齿缝里的菜梗——明明知道有东西别在那儿，但舌尖就是够不到那个位置。他翻了个身，面朝墙壁，闭上眼睛试图像前世那样把杂念压下去——当年蹲点的时候，再难熬的夜也能闭眼就睡，醒了就是精神抖擞的一整个人。
他索性不睡了，双手枕在脑后，睁着眼睛在黑夜里把前世的卷宗一架子一架子的过。
玄镜司的密档库里，靠东边那面墙有四排架子，专门放各门派的徽记图谱。那些是多年来被朝廷剿灭的门派档案，其中也有玄镜司剿灭的。
朝廷定的规矩便是律法，一些事情除非获得朝廷特许，否则做了就是犯法。其中，血修炼出来的手段凶，走偏的门派比灵修玄修多，所以卷宗里被剿的血修门派确实比其他两系多一些。
那些年被剿灭的门派，封面上都画着各自的标记，归档的时候他亲自过的目。
苏尘闭上眼睛，仔细回想那些标记。
突然，他猛地睁开眼。
想起来了，碧血宗。
但陶夭夭画下来的那个残印，不是碧血宗原版的徽记。
他闭着眼睛再次确认。碧血宗的徽记他看了不止一次——当年剿灭碧血宗的卷宗他翻过，封面上那个记号的结构他记得很清楚。
但太像了。
弧线的弧度几乎一模一样，尖角的角度也差不了多少，只是整个布局往左边偏了一点点，像是有人照着原版的样子重新画了一个，但手抖了一寸。不是同一枚印章盖出来的——倒像是同一个人换了把刀，凭记忆重新刻了一枚。
改了。

苏尘在黑暗里睁开眼睛。
碧血宗灭于十七年前。
这个时间卡在脑子里岿然不动。十七年了，一个门派的徽记不可能还在江湖上流通——除非有人捡起来继续用。而且不是照搬原版，是做了改动之后继续用。
沿袭。
改过的版本。
他在脑子里把这条线扯了一下。碧血宗灭门以后，有余孽跑了——这种事不少见，剿匪从来都是剿得掉山头剿不干净根须。那些跑了的人要想重新活过来，就得换个名字、换个地方、换个招牌。他们沿袭了老门派的生意路子，沿袭了老门派的药材渠道，甚至沿袭了老门派的徽记——只是怕被认出来，所以改了图样。然后就有了养血堂。
陶夭夭画下来的那个残片——
是养血堂的徽记。
串上了。苏尘翻了个身，面朝墙壁，把这几件事在脑子里一字排开。碧血宗灭于十七年前，余孽重建了养血堂。养血堂做的还是血修的药材买卖，路子和老门派一模一样——收药材、供血修、赚黑钱。然后养血堂也出了事，具体什么事他不知道，但陶家帮养血堂收过药材，手上还留着那批货没出手。
现在有人找上门来了。
用的是沿袭碧血宗改过的徽记——那是养血堂自己的记号。所以来的不是别人，就是养血堂自己的人。
他安静地躺了一会儿，对着墙壁把那口气缓缓吐出来。
事情是串起来了，但串起来之后并没有让他觉得轻松多少。
知道来的是谁，和知道怎么挡——那是两回事。
鸡叫第二遍的时候他醒了。
其实严格来说不是“醒了“，他根本没怎么睡着。只是鸡叫了，天快亮了，躺着也没意义了。他翻身坐起来，在床沿上坐了片刻，让身体从半梦半醒的状态里缓过来，然后穿上外衣，推开房门走了出去。
初春的早晨还有寒气。
院子里一股清冷的气息扑面而来，带着夜里积下来的露水和干草的味道。马棚顶上覆了一层薄薄的白霜，在灰蒙蒙的天光下泛着淡白。刘叔已经在给马添草料了——他永远起得比鸡早，鸡还没叫他已经在干活了。他看见苏尘从屋里出来，没多问什么，只是抬了抬下巴指了指灶房的方向，说了句“粥还热着“。
苏尘应了一声，走到井边打了半桶水上来。
冰凉的井水泼在脸上的时候，他觉得脑子里那些盘了一夜的东西终于被冲开了一条缝。他弯腰又掬了一捧水搓了把脸，然后站直了，拿袖子随便擦了一把脸上的水珠。

今天没课，苏尘先回王府一趟，免得王妃担心，等到傍晚再行动。
傍晚，他先回到马场，如果真遇到事情，需要有人去喊人，他决定叫上阿离。
content_en:
Su Chen did not return to the palace.
After three years, this habit has become so natural that it doesn't feel like a habit anymore - he would just rest at the racecourse when he was late for practice, lost in thought, or just too lazy to walk the two-quarter-hour journey back home. At first, Qingluo would bring a change of clothes, but later Liu Hanyan got used to it. Occasionally, she would send someone to bring him a message, saying, "Remember to add some clothes so you don't catch a cold," and she would no longer urge him to go back.
The hard bed was not as soft as the one in the palace, but he was used to it.
I just can't sleep tonight.
That mark kept spinning in my mind all night.
Su Chen lay on the hard bed, staring at the lines on the beams that were blackened by the oil lamp, watching them slowly blur and then become clearer in the darkness. There was no movement outside the window, except for the occasional muffled sound of hooves hitting the ground in the stable, followed by the rustling sound of fodder being moved, and then silence again.
He had been lying there for two hours. Can't sleep.
The sharp angles and arcs in my mind were turning over and over, like a vegetable stem stuck in the gap between my teeth - I knew there was something stuck there, but the tip of my tongue just couldn't reach that spot. He turned over, faced the wall, closed his eyes and tried to suppress distracting thoughts like he did in his previous life - when he was squatting, he could close his eyes and fall asleep no matter how difficult the night was, and when he woke up, he would be full of energy.
He simply stopped sleeping, put his hands behind his head, opened his eyes and went through the files from his previous life one by one in the dark night.
In the secret archives of Xuanjing Division, there are four rows of shelves on the east wall, which are dedicated to storing the emblem maps of various sects. Those are the archives of sects that have been wiped out by the imperial court over the years, including those that were wiped out by the Xuanjing Division.
The rules set by the court are laws. Unless something is authorized by the court, it is illegal to do it. Among them, the methods of blood cultivation are fierce, and there are more sects that go astray than the spiritual cultivation and metaphysics, so the number of blood cultivation sects that have been wiped out in the file is indeed more than the other two sects.
The sects that were wiped out in those years all have their own marks on the covers, which he personally checked when filing.
Su Chen closed his eyes and recalled those marks carefully.
Suddenly, his eyes shot open.
I remembered it, Jade Blood Sect.
But the residual seal painted by Tao Yaoyao was not the original emblem of the Blue Blood Sect.
He closed his eyes and confirmed again. He had seen the emblem of the Jade Blood Sect more than once - he had flipped through the files on the eradication of the Jade Blood Sect, and he remembered the structure of the mark on the cover very clearly.
But it’s so similar.
The curvature of the arc is almost exactly the same, and the angle of the sharp corners is not much different, but the whole layout is a little bit to the left, as if someone has redrawn it according to the original one, but the hand is shaking an inch. It's not stamped with the same seal - it's more like the same person changed the knife and carved a new one from memory.
Changed.
Su Chen opened his eyes in the darkness.
The Jade Blood Sect was destroyed seventeen years ago.
This time is stuck in my mind. Seventeen years later, it is impossible for a sect's emblem to still be circulating in the world - unless someone picks it up and continues to use it. And it's not a copy of the original version, it's made changes and continues to be used.
lineage.
Modified version.
He tugged at the thread in his mind. After the Jade Blood Sect was wiped out, some of the remnants escaped - this kind of thing is not uncommon. The bandits have always been able to wipe out the mountains but not the roots. If those who ran away wanted to live again, they had to change their names, places, and signs. They followed the old sect's business methods, the old sect's medicinal materials channels, and even the old sect's emblem - but they were afraid of being recognized, so they changed the pattern. Then there was the Blood Yangtang.
The fragment painted by Tao Yaoyao——
It is the emblem of Yangxuetang.
On a skewer. Su Chen turned over, faced the wall, and lined up these things in his mind. The Jade Blood Sect was destroyed seventeen years ago, and the remnants rebuilt the Blood Yangtang. Blood Yangtang is still engaged in selling medicinal materials for blood cultivation, and its methods are exactly the same as those of the old sect.It's the same - collecting medicinal materials, donating blood for repair, and making dirty money. Then something happened to the Blood Yangtang. He didn't know what happened specifically, but the Tao family helped the Blood Yangtang collect the medicinal materials and still kept the batch of goods.
Now someone is coming to your door.
The emblem used was modified from the Blue Blood Sect—it was the Yangxue Hall’s own mark. So those who came were none other than the Blood Yangxue Hall’s own people.
He lay quietly for a while and slowly exhaled against the wall.
Things were connected, but it didn't make him feel much relieved after they were connected.
Knowing who is coming and knowing how to block it - those are two different things.
He woke up when the cock crowed for the second time.
In fact, strictly speaking, he wasn't "awake", he wasn't asleep at all. It’s just that the rooster crows and it’s almost dawn, so there’s no point in lying down. He turned over and sat up, sitting on the edge of the bed for a moment to let his body recover from the half-asleep state, then put on his coat, opened the door and walked out.
There is still a chill in the early spring morning.
A cool breath came from the yard, carrying the smell of dew and hay that had accumulated during the night. The roof of the stable was covered with a thin layer of hoarfrost, glowing pale white under the gray sky. Uncle Liu is already adding fodder to the horses - he always gets up earlier than the chickens, and is already working before the chickens crow. When he saw Su Chen coming out of the house, he didn't ask any questions. He just raised his chin and pointed in the direction of the kitchen and said, "The porridge is still hot."
Su Chen responded, walked to the well and fetched half a bucket of water.
When the cold well water splashed on his face, he felt that the things that had been sitting in his mind all night were finally washed away. He bent down and took another handful of water and rubbed his face, then stood up straight and casually wiped the water droplets on his face with his sleeve.
There is no class today, so Su Chen will go back to the palace first so as not to worry the princess and wait until evening before taking action.
In the evening, he returned to the racecourse first. If something really happened and someone needed to be called, he decided to call A Li.
